visualCharacteristics.purpose: image carousel, one slide at a time, neighbours peeking in, optional captions
traits: slides (container - 4px) / 1.2 wide, 2:1 images, 20px apart, current slide centred
track bleeds to the window edges
caption LufthansaText 14px bold under the image
next/previous arrows at the window edges from 1025px, dots below

contentPattern.structure: 2 columns. One row per slide: cell 1 the image (with alt text), cell 2 an optional caption (empty for none). Rows without an image are not slides. Optional label rows (2 cells, no image): Carousel label, Previous label, Next label, Slide label ('{n} of {total}'), with English and German defaults by page language. One image: no controls; no image: the block is hidden.

usage.description: Lufthansa image components inside a single-slide swiper (.carousel:has(.swiper-single-slide)): 100 years pages, campaign pages, Insights articles, class pages.

reuseGuidance: Use for a row of images shown one at a time. For several teaser cards at once use carousel-cards; for an inline preview that opens a modal gallery use carousel-lightbox.
